subcategory_text: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 9.1, Annex A.5.1, Annex A.5.19
CRI Profile v2.0: GV.OV-01, GV.OV-01.01, GV.OV-01.02, GV.OV-01.03
implementation_examples: Measure how well the risk management strategy and risk results have helped leaders make decisions and achieve organizational objectives
Examine whether cybersecurity risk strategies that impede operations or innovation should be adjusted
assessment_objectives: Determine whether cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction.
Determine whether activities are conducted to measure how well the risk management strategy and risk results have helped leaders make decisions and achieve organizational objectives.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that examine whether cybersecurity risk strategies that impede operations or innovation should be adjusted.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
